rationale: Iran-US Hormuz talks continue without breakthrough; Serbian president resignation is regional political shift but no immediate impact on Romania; nor'easter remains distant background.

top_events.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
top_events.label: Iran maintains diplomacy after US rejects Hormuz deal
top_events.summary: Iran's foreign minister responds to Trump's rejection of Strait reopening plan. Energy supply situation unchanged for Romania.

top_events.title: Embattled Serbian president resigns, paving way for early elections
top_events.label: Serbian president Vučić resigns amid corruption protests
top_events.summary: Serbia's president steps down after prolonged protests over corruption allegations. Regional political shift but no immediate spillover to Romania.

top_events.title: One dead as nor'easter storm pummels New York and New Jersey
top_events.label: Nor'easter storm kills one, affects US East Coast
top_events.summary: Major US storm continues with one fatality. Distant climate event with no direct impact on Romania.
